name: io.github.gator8125/chromewalk
title: ChromeWalk
description: ChromeWalk - Local browser automation toolkit for AI agents. Real-browser bypasses for WAF, JS challenges, dynamic content. Fetch, flow, webinspect, screenshot, harvest, API testing, and more via standard MCP - all on your machine, never in the cloud.

environmentVariables.name: CHROMEWALK_LICENSE
environmentVariables.description: License key (sign up at https://api.chromewalk.com/register.html or run `chromewalk register <your-email>`). Read once when the MCP server starts and used to activate this device if it is not already activated. Alternatively run `chromewalk activate <key>`. Without an activated license every tool call returns a license-required error.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.license_requirement: License key required to use ChromeWalk tools - sign up at https://api.chromewalk.com/register.html or run `chromewalk register <your-email>`; activate via the CHROMEWALK_LICENSE env var, the bundle's license_key setting, or `chromewalk activate <key>`. There is no keyless trial: until a license is activated, every tool call returns a license-required error. An offline grace window applies only to an already-activated license that cannot reach the license server.
